upgradeDesktop: This copy of merak came with the desktop app. Update it from the desktop app.
upgradeStopEngine: The engine is running. Stop it with merak stop before you upgrade.
logsNone: No logs yet. The engine writes them once it has run.
sandboxWaiting: Sandbox: waiting for a free sandbox account
sandboxNotSetUp: Sandbox: not set up yet. It needs one administrator approval.
sandboxSetupHint: Run merak sandbox setup to turn it on.
sandboxLimit.loopback-open: Commands can still reach services on this computer (localhost).
sandboxLimit.own-addresses-open: Commands can still reach this computer's own network addresses.
sandboxLimit.port-only: TCP is limited by port only, so a command could reach that port on another host.
sandboxLimit.udp-open: UDP traffic (for example DNS) is not restricted.
sandboxSettingUp: Setting up the sandbox. Windows will ask for administrator approval; the first time can take a few minutes.
sandboxResetting: Resetting the sandbox. Windows will ask for administrator approval.
sandboxNothingToReset: Nothing to reset: the sandbox was never set up.
sandboxStopFirst: Stop the engine with merak stop, then run merak sandbox reset again.
doctorFailed: %d problem(s) found. If you cannot fix them, run merak bug-report and attach the file to an issue.
serviceInstalled: The engine will start at login (start at login is on).
serviceUninstalled: The engine will no longer start at login.
bugReportNext: Keys, tokens and conversation text are removed. Open an issue and attach the file: %s
importDone: Imported %d conversations, %d groups, %d agents, %d plans, %d memories; skipped %d.
importAdapters: Not imported, because they are scripts you wrote: %s. Add them again with a built-in Claude Code, Codex, opencode, pi, ACP or command adapter.
